newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle trade thin at $68 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle trade thin at $68 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle trade was slow near midday Tuesday, with a small number of heifers trading in Kansas at $68.00 per cwt, steady with Monday and last week, feedlot sources said.
Further bids at $68.00 were still being passed by owners pricing cattle at $69.00 to $70.00, they said.
Fed cattle prices this week were seen underpinned by firm beef demand and lighter supplies of market-ready cattle than last week.
Active packer demand last week pulled some finished cattle ahead from this week's showlists, cattle feeders said.
